description: This PHP class 'ServerRequestCreator' constructs server request objects from global variables or arrays, implementing PSR-7 interfaces for HTTP message handling. It handles request creation, header parsing, URI building, and file uploads.

classes.name: ServerRequestCreator
classes.description: A final class implementing PSR-7 server request creation from global variables or arrays, handling headers, URI, and uploaded files.

methods.name: fromGlobals
methods.description: Creates a ServerRequestInterface object from PHP global variables.

methods.name: fromArrays
methods.description: Constructs a server request object from provided server, headers, cookies, GET, POST, files, and body arrays.

methods.name: getHeadersFromServer
methods.description: Extracts HTTP headers from server variables, mimicking Zend Diactoros behavior.

methods.name: getMethodFromEnv
methods.description: Retrieves the HTTP method from environment array.

methods.name: getUriFromEnvWithHTTP
methods.description: Builds a URI object from environment array, ensuring scheme is set.

methods.name: normalizeFiles
methods.description: Normalizes uploaded files array into UploadedFileInterface instances.

methods.name: createUploadedFileFromSpec
methods.description: Creates an UploadedFileInterface object from a $_FILES style array.

methods.name: normalizeNestedFileSpec
methods.description: Normalizes nested file specifications into UploadedFileInterface objects.

methods.name: createUriFromArray
methods.description: Constructs a URI object from server variables.
